01 · Sept 2025
Multi-Mic Real-Time Audio DSP Pipeline with ML Anomaly Detection
Triple-layer real-time audio processing pipeline on Teensy 4.1 with dual ADMP401 MEMS microphones. Reduced unauthorized audio injection rate from 90% → 7% through signal correlation and ML-based anomaly detection.
82–88% correlation for speech · <50ms latency · 50 kHz sampling
Teensy 4.1 C++ Python FFT/DTMF Cross-Correlation VAD
02 · 2025–2026
DSP Audio Processing Suite
Polyphase asynchronous sample rate converter (44.1→48 kHz), FIR/Parks-McClellan filter benchmarks, and LMS adaptive noise canceller. Validated against MATLAB achieving >70 dB SNR.
SNR: 5 dB → 30+ dB · Kaiser β=5.65 · L=160/M=147
MATLAB Signal Processing Toolbox FIR/IIR LMS Multirate DSP
03 · Jan 2026
Embedded IoT Fall Detection & Health Monitoring
Real-time fall detection wearable with BLE health alerts on nRF7002 DK using Zephyr RTOS. MPU6050 + MAX30102 sensors with custom DTS APIs and Red-Note BLE notifications.
Zephyr RTOS priority scheduling · BLE notifications
nRF7002 DK Zephyr RTOS BLE MPU6050 MAX30102 DTS
04 · Jun–Aug 2025
OTA Firmware Update System (ESP32 + LTE)
Secure OTA firmware update system for ESP32 using Quectel EC200U 4G LTE via HTTPS over cellular. Dual-partition architecture with SHA-256 validation and atomic flash operations.
SHA-256 validation · AT command UART · PDP context management
ESP32 C/C++ 4G LTE TCP/IP HTTPS ESP-IDF

Network Analysis using Colosseum
Multi-node wired/wireless network topologies using ns-3. UDP Echo client–server with Wireshark analysis of IP, UDP, and ICMP packets. Validated routing and forwarding behavior.
